subject: Commercial: On-Prem license true-up, observability add-on split, and SRE response tiering
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cygnusbio.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cygnusbio.com, c.meza@cygnusbio.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on on-prem true-up cadence + observability split

Markus — thanks for the draft SOW. Quick clarifying questions from Procurement before we loop Legal:

1) True-up cadence: the SOW mentions a quarterly true-up for operator licenses. For our accounting we need either an annual true-up (preferred) or a firm monthly reporting window with a 30-day billing settlement. Can Redwood support an annual true-up with a capped reconciliation delta?

2) Observability addon: our SecOps wants observability telemetry retained 18 months. The SOW bundles observability into the platform fee. Can you split observability as a separately itemized add-on (metered by GB/day) so we can decide retention vs cost?

3) SRE response tiers: we need a 24x7 oncall escalation path with defined RTOs for P1/P2. We are evaluating whether to take the standard response tier or negotiate a 4-hr P1 SLA with a higher retainer. Can you share the delta in monthly retainer for 4-hr P1 vs 8-hr?

Attached: Cygnus_Cost_Model_v2.xlsx (internal forecast) and our procurement checklist. We intend to get commercial sign-off this month. Appreciate a short response with numbers so our CFO can model.

Thanks,
Lena
Director, Procurement
Cygnus Bio
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cygnusbio.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on on-prem true-up cadence + observability split

Lena — thanks for the clear list and the model (very helpful). High-level answers below; I copied Irene (legal) and Marissa (commercial) for the rate card numbers.

1) True-up cadence: We can offer an annual true-up in lieu of quarterly, with a capped reconciliation exposure of 12% of committed operator licenses per year. Mechanic: if actual usage exceeds commitment by >12%, there is an incremental true-up at the annual renewal; for smaller deltas we provide a one-time credit to smooth first-year adoption. This is a concession we can make for multi-year commitments (>=24 months).

2) Observability addon: Agree to split observability from platform fee. We'll meter by average GB/day ingested to your observability cluster and offer tiered retention: 90 days (base), 365 days (mid), 18 months (premium). Pricing: base included; 365d = $0.08/GB/day, 18mo = $0.12/GB/day. We will surface an estimator in the console to help your SecOps forecast spend.

3) SRE response tiers: Rough monthly retainer deltas (ballpark): 8-hr P1 standard retainer = included in Starter SRE band; 4-hr P1 = additional $12k/month for your footprint; 1-hr oncall (Gold) = $28k/month. These numbers depend on committed capacity and timezones — Marissa will follow up with an exact tiered quote.

Attachments: I'll attach a redlined SOW that reflects the observability split and the annual true-up language. We can also bake the 12% exposure cap into an appendix.

If that approach works, can we schedule a 30-min call Wed to finalize numbers and an initial SOW? I can bring Finance/Legal.

Best,
Markus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Questions on on-prem true-up cadence + observability split

Markus / Marissa — forwarding Lena's note and Markus' quick reply. A few legal/ops points we should confirm before the call:

- The 12% reconciliation cap is fine but we should add language that allows for a one-time move of excess operator licenses into a prepaid pool at a discounted uplift (to avoid invoice surprises).
- Confirm observability metering definition: is it GB/day ingested pre-ingest (agent side) or post-index (after compression)? We should define the meter at the agent level to avoid ambiguity.
- SRE retainer: require an SLA table in SOW with exact RTOs, escalation contacts, and a single defined credit formula for missed RTOs (not ad-hoc credits).

Marissa — please prepare a short table for Wed that shows: committed operator band vs monthly retainer, delta for 4-hr P1 and 1-hr Gold, and the observability per-GB examples (10GB/day, 100GB/day). I will draft contract language for the true-up cap and prepaid pool.

Irene
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Meza <c.meza@cygnusbio.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cygnusbio.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial: On-Prem license true-up, observability add-on split, and SRE response tiering

Team — quick follow after internal finance call. Cygnus is comfortable with the annual true-up and the 12% cap for a 36-month commitment. Two asks before we lock: 

1) Can Redwood convert 50% of our one-time implementation fee into month-by-month credits against the SRE retainer for the first 6 months? This helps our cashflow.
2) For observability: we prefer the meter to be agent-side (pre-ingest) and request a 5% tolerance (i.e., measurements within 5% are subject to no billing adjustments).

If you can confirm those two items and produce a redlined SOW/DocuSign link, we can route to Legal and Finance for signature. Appreciate the quick turn.

Thanks,
Carlos
Head of IT Programs
Cygnus Bio
